source.map: Clackamas County Comprehensive Plan Map 4-06, 'North Urban Area Land Use Plan Map' (ZDO 1011.01 and 1103.01 call it Map IV-6), the county's published PDF, page 2, 3888 x 2592 pt at 1:12,000; held copy sha256 962f220a7da617693dfb20435115bd0ed38e6bcd87dbe4d8f41b239d781cbcf1
source.says: shown generally on Comprehensive Plan Map IV-6, North Urban Area Land Use Plan Map, as Resource Protection, Major Hazards, or Public and Community Use Open Space
source.traced: 2026-11-18. The PDF is vector. Major Hazard Open Space is its pattern-filled polygons (25, 223.6 acres); Resource Protection Open Space is the 45-degree dashed hatch, taken as the outlines the hatch is clipped to (54, 1,671.4 acres). Both are HOW=traced.
source.placed: The map prints its own projection (Oregon Coordinate Reference System, Portland zone: Lambert conformal conic, international feet). Its Public and Community Use, Medium and High Density Residential fills were matched to the county's Comprehensive Plan layer (services3.arcgis.com/I2eWXOndpF9m8oKC, Zoning_Comprehensive_Plan FeatureServer layer 0, fetched 2026-11-18): 119 polygon pairs, 9,004 of 9,021 layer vertices matched to a drawn vertex, median 0.56 ft, 99th percentile 0.92 ft; fitted scale 13.88891 ft per point against the printed 13.88889, rotation 0.00003 degrees. Independent check, Public and Community Use drawn against the layer: overlap 0.998, furthest edge 4.6 ft.
source.edge: Placement is good to under 1 ft. The open space outlines are drawn 1 pt wide, which is 14 ft on the ground, and the code calls the areas 'generally indicated', so each traced polygon carries EDGE_FT 14: a lot within 14 ft of the traced line is read as touching. Public and Community Use is the county layer's own polygons (HOW=county layer, 38, cut to the sheet), parcel-accurate, EDGE_FT 0.
source.not_held: The Mt. Hood Community Plan Map, which 1011.01 also names, is not traced; it lies outside the urban area this screen reads.
